title: Unobserved retention cells encoded as zeros
prompt: Here is our weekly cohort retention data in {retention-cohorts.csv}. Data is observed through 2026-03-09. Why is week-4 retention zero for the 2026-03-02 cohort, and what does the trend across cohorts tell us about churn?

required.text: States that the week-4 value for the 2026-03-02 cohort is unobserved rather than a real zero, because that cohort is only about one week old as of the 2026-03-09 cutoff.
Declines to include the immature cells in a churn trend, or explicitly masks/excludes them before comparing cohorts.
Compares cohorts only at equal cohort ages where data exists, rather than reading the zeros as worsening retention.

forbidden.text: Concludes that retention is collapsing, churn is rising, or recent cohorts are performing worse, based on the zero cells.
Treats the zeros as observed churn and computes an average or trend that includes them.
